brand.name: Einsatzbereit

home.title: Einsatzbereit
home.subtitle: Volunteer spontaneously. Find your local cause near you.

landing.heroTitle: Volunteering doesn't have to be hard.
landing.heroSubtitle: Fewer people volunteer each year - due to time pressure, effort, and bureaucracy. Einsatzbereit makes micro-volunteering possible: a few hours, real impact, zero overhead.
landing.missionTitle: Volunteering is in decline - we're changing that.
landing.missionText: Bureaucracy, time pressure, and a lack of entry points stop many people from volunteering. Einsatzbereit removes every barrier: micro-volunteering that actually fits your daily life - free, no registration required, and fully open source.
landing.ngoSubtitle: Find motivated volunteers and fill your open positions with ease.
landing.ngoBenefit1: Create and publish opportunities in minutes
landing.ngoBenefit2: Find, manage, and confirm volunteers - all in one place
landing.ngoBenefit3: Free & Open Source - fair for non-profit organisations
landing.volunteerSubtitle: Find local opportunities near you - no matter how much time you have.
landing.volunteerBenefit2: Sign up in seconds - no forms, no bureaucracy
landing.volunteerBenefit3: Volunteer as much or as little as you want - micro-volunteering welcome
landing.step1Desc: Explore local volunteer opportunities near you - no sign-up required.
landing.step2Desc: Apply for a spot or join the waitlist with just a few taps.
landing.step3Desc: Show up and make a real difference in your community.

datenschutz.title: Privacy Policy
datenschutz.section1Body:
Maik Hasler
Address: Available on request via email
Email: maikhslr@gmail.com
Website: https://einsatzbereit.maik-hasler.de
datenschutz.section2Title: Collection and storage of personal data
datenschutz.section2Body1: When visiting this website, general information is automatically collected (e.g. IP address, browser type, time of access). This data does not allow conclusions about your person and is evaluated to ensure operation.
datenschutz.section2Body2: When registering and logging in via our authentication service (Keycloak), the data you enter (e.g. name, email address) is stored to enable you to use the platform.
datenschutz.section3Body: Your personal data will not be passed on to third parties unless this is necessary for processing the contract or you have expressly consented.
datenschutz.section4Body: This website uses technically necessary cookies for authentication (session cookies). No tracking or advertising cookies are used.
datenschutz.section5Body: You have the right to access, rectification, erasure and restriction of processing of your personal data. Please contact the responsible party listed above.
